playbookOutputs: Renewed 3-Year CIDB Register of Contractors Certificate
Triennial Grading Re-Assessment Working Schedule (for Grades 2–9)
CRS Renewal Confirmation & New 36-Month Expiry Date
playbookCommonFailures: Director certified IDs or bank confirmation letter older than 3 months at submission
Graded contractor (Grades 2–9) fails to supply signed AFS or completion certificates within the 5-year look-back window, resulting in a downgrade to Grade 1
Company directors on CIPC CoR 14.3 do not match the directors listed on the CIDB CRS / CSD profile
SARS TCS PIN is non-compliant or CIDB statutory renewal fees remain unpaid by the contractor

informationToProvide.label: Current CIDB CRS Number, Class(es) of Works & Current Grade(s) Being Renewed
informationToProvide.helpText: Provide your CIDB CRS number and the class(es) of works and grade(s) you are renewing for the next 3-year cycle.

informationToProvide.label: CIDB CRS Portal Login Username
informationToProvide.helpText: Your CIDB CRS online login username.

informationToProvide.label: CIDB CRS Portal Login Password
informationToProvide.helpText: Your CIDB CRS online login password (stored encrypted).

informationToProvide.label: Current / Expiring CIDB Registration Certificate
informationToProvide.helpText: Upload your current or expiring CIDB certificate.
informationToProvide.aiHint: Current CIDB Register of Contractors certificate showing the CRS number, current grade(s), class(es) of works, and 3-year expiry date.

informationToProvide.label: Company Registration Certificate (CIPC CoR 14.3)
informationToProvide.helpText: Upload your CIPC CoR 14.3 registration certificate.
informationToProvide.aiHint: Official CIPC CoR14.3 showing the registered enterprise name, registration number, and current active directors.

informationToProvide.label: Certified SA ID Copies of All Active Directors (Not Older Than 3 Months)
informationToProvide.helpText: Upload certified SA ID copies (< 3 months) for all active directors on the CoR 14.3.
informationToProvide.aiHint: Mandatory CIPC KYC Invariant: South African citizens MUST submit a certified SA ID (Smart ID Card front AND back, or Green Barcoded ID Book) certified within the last 3 months by a Commissioner of Oaths or SAPS — passports are NOT accepted for SA citizens. Foreign nationals ONLY may submit a certified/apostilled foreign passport accompanied by a valid visa/permit. Verify legible ID/passport number, full legal names, and certification stamp date within 90 days.

informationToProvide.label: Proof of Physical Business Address (Not Older Than 3 Months)
informationToProvide.helpText: Upload a utility bill, municipal account, or lease agreement (< 3 months) in the company name.
informationToProvide.aiHint: Proof of physical business address dated within 90 days in the registered company name.

informationToProvide.label: Business Bank Confirmation Letter (In the Company Name, Not Older Than 3 Months)
informationToProvide.helpText: Upload a stamped or QR-verified bank confirmation letter (< 3 months) in the company name.
informationToProvide.aiHint: Official bank confirmation letter from a registered SA bank in the company legal name, dated within 90 days.

informationToProvide.label: SARS Tax Compliance Status (TCS) PIN Letter
informationToProvide.helpText: Upload the unexpired SARS Tax Compliance Status (TCS) PIN letter for the company.
informationToProvide.aiHint: SARS Tax Compliance Status (TCS) PIN letter for the company showing Compliant status.

informationToProvide.label: Latest 2 Years Signed Annual Financial Statements (Required for Grades 2–9)
informationToProvide.conditionalQuestion: Are you renewing a CIDB grading of Grade 2 or higher?
informationToProvide.helpText: For Grades 2–9, upload your signed Annual Financial Statements for the past 2 financial years so CIDB can re-verify turnover and available capital.
informationToProvide.aiHint: Signed Annual Financial Statements for the past two financial years used by CIDB to test best annual turnover and net asset value / available capital.

informationToProvide.label: Completed Project Completion Certificates, Letters of Award & Payment Proof (Required for Grades 2–9)
alternatives: Letters of Award + Final Payment Certificates
informationToProvide.conditionalQuestion: Are you renewing a CIDB grading of Grade 2 or higher?
informationToProvide.helpText: For Grades 2–9, upload signed Practical/Final Completion Certificates and Letters of Award within the 5-year look-back window.
informationToProvide.aiHint: Signed project completion certificates and letters of award in the company name showing contract value, scope/class of works, and completion date.

fulfillmentChecklist.title: Collect 3-year CIDB renewal documents, CRS credentials, and Grade 2–9 financials/track record
fulfillmentChecklist.doneCriteria: Current CIDB certificate, CRS login, CoR 14.3, certified IDs, proof of address, bank letter, TCS PIN, and (for Grades 2–9) AFS & project certificates received
fulfillmentChecklist.aiInstructions: Every 36 months the CIDB conducts a full re-registration / re-assessment of the contractor. Confirm whether the client is renewing Grade 1 (documents only) or Grades 2–9 (requires full financial capability & works capability re-assessment). Remind that CIDB statutory fees are payable directly to the CIDB.

fulfillmentChecklist.title: Verify KYC documents, TCS PIN, CSD sync, and Grade 2–9 financial/project track record
fulfillmentChecklist.doneCriteria: All uploads verified < 90 days; TCS PIN compliant; Grade 2–9 turnover, available capital, and largest contract verified against CIDB thresholds
fulfillmentChecklist.aiInstructions: Check CoR14.3 directors against certified IDs and CRS/CSD profile. For Grades 2–9, verify that the two years signed AFS and completion certificates support the renewal grade.

fulfillmentChecklist.title: Prepare 3-year CIDB renewal hand-off sheet and grading schedule for Kevin
fulfillmentChecklist.doneCriteria: Triennial renewal hand-off sheet and grade verification schedule drafted for review
fulfillmentChecklist.aiInstructions: Compile all CRS renewal fields, director particulars, TCS PIN, bank details, and (for Grades 2–9) turnover, net asset value, and largest completed contract schedule.

fulfillmentChecklist.title: Stage 3-year CIDB renewal on the CIDB CRS portal
fulfillmentChecklist.doneCriteria: 3-year renewal staged and submitted on CIDB CRS with all supporting documents; CIDB fee invoice sent to client
fulfillmentChecklist.aiInstructions: Log into CIDB CRS using the client credentials, capture the 36-month renewal and any director/address updates, upload all verified supporting documents, and send the CIDB statutory fee payment reference to the client.

fulfillmentChecklist.title: Monitor CIDB assessment and follow up until the renewed 3-year certificate is issued
fulfillmentChecklist.doneCriteria: Renewed 3-year CIDB certificate issued on CRS
fulfillmentChecklist.aiInstructions: Check CRS status at Days 7, 14, and 21. If CIDB assessors raise a verification query on financials or project references, escalate to Kevin with the exact query.

fulfillmentChecklist.title: Deliver renewed 3-year CIDB certificate to the client portal
fulfillmentChecklist.doneCriteria: Renewed 3-year CIDB certificate posted to Communication History with annual confirmation dates noted
fulfillmentChecklist.aiInstructions: Deliver the renewed CIDB certificate and remind the client that annual confirmations are still required in Years 1 and 2 between 3-year renewals.
